justification: Legislation-monitor -> bulk-index refresh connector: maps changed instrument to a scoped, ready-to-run recompute runbook appended to the alert (command-in-alert; no execution, no DB writes at runtime)

pre_impl.existing_data: instrument_registry holds 23 LEP and 2 SEPP active keys; lot_search_index.lga_name holds the 128 overlay LGA names the recompute commands must target
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: naive slug-to-LGA transform only resolves 19 of 23 keys; merged or renamed councils (Parramatta, Canterbury-Bankstown, Sutherland Shire, The Hills Shire) need explicit overrides verified against the live overlay names
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: new pure module reusing the existing legislation_monitor alert path; it appends text only and runs zero DB or network calls, so the static override map is baked in rather than queried at runtime

functions.name: instrument_lga
functions.input: instrument_key string such as bayside_lep_2021 or sepp_housing_2021
functions.output: overlay LGA name for an LEP, or None for any statewide SEPP key
functions.if_none: returns None for non-LEP keys so the caller emits a statewide note instead of a per-LGA command

functions.name: build_refresh_runbook
functions.input: list of changed instrument tuples each holding key and human label
functions.output: operator-facing runbook text block appended to the change alert
functions.if_none: empty changed list returns an empty string so callers append it unconditionally

functions.name: _lep_block
functions.input: the LEP label, instrument key, and resolved overlay LGA name
functions.output: scoped three-command chain re-ingest then assign then recompute for that LGA
functions.if_none: only called when instrument_lga returned a real LGA, so the LGA is never None here

values: N/A - emits command strings only; no regulatory values computed or stored
queries: N/A - no DB queries in new code; the existing monitor queries are unchanged

break_it.scenario: Changed instrument is a merged/renamed council (Parramatta/Canterbury-Bankstown/Sutherland/The Hills)
break_it.what_happens: Naive slug transform would emit the wrong --lga name, sending a command that processes 0 lots
break_it.how: _LGA_OVERRIDES dict verified vs lot_search_index.lga_name; regression test test_lep_uses_override_lga_not_naive asserts naive name absent, override present

break_it.scenario: Changed instrument is a statewide SEPP
break_it.what_happens: A per-LGA recompute command would be nonsensical (SEPP affects all councils)
break_it.how: instrument_lga returns None for non-_lep_ keys -> _sepp_block (statewide note, no build command); test asserts build_lot_search_index.py absent

break_it.scenario: No instruments changed in this monitor run
break_it.what_happens: Empty runbook string appended to the alert (no-op)
break_it.how: returns '' so callers append unconditionally; runbook only reached inside the existing 'if changed' branch anyway

post_merge.manual_verify: On next Railway legislation_monitor cron with a real change (or forced --dry-run change), confirm the Telegram alert carries the scoped runbook. NOTE: the emitted recompute rebuilds from spatial_overlays, corrupt for ~26 councils (separate pending fix); the runbook re-ingests overlays first so it pulls fresh source, but the FSR ingest field-mapping fix is still outstanding.
